posts.name: Alex
posts.cooked: Aerial Ace doesn't get applied to your regular card play, it is a card play in of itself. Activating its effect causes you to play a card, and for that card play only the non-pregame rules about playing cards don't apply. So when you used it to put Silly Match 3 Game into play, that card play wasn't affected by Thunderwave( but the use of the Aerial Ace ability was; it still had the 50% chance of failure). In Sentinels language, Aerial Ace is like a power that lets you play a card. So now you just have your ordinary card play left.

Phantaskippy decided this game wasn't challenging him enough, and took a vow to speak only in iambic pentameter.
